series.title: limited-service restaurants: places per 10,000 residents
series.label: Calculated
series.source: U.S. Census Bureau, County Business Patterns, bulk county files (public domain); U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program, county totals (public domain)

series.label: Observed

series.label: Observed
series.source: U.S. Census Bureau, County Business Patterns, bulk county files (public domain)

series.title: limited-service restaurants: establishments (QCEW)
series.label: Observed
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW), open-data annual county slices
series.note: private sector, annual average. QCEW and County Business Patterns count differently; their figures are never added together or averaged.

series.title: limited-service restaurants: jobs (QCEW)
series.label: Observed
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW), open-data annual county slices

series.label: Observed
series.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW), open-data annual county slices
series.note: total wages paid by these employers: wages paid, not sales. QCEW and County Business Patterns count differently; their figures are never added together or averaged.

series.title: new housing units permitted

series.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Building Permits Survey, annual county files (public domain)
series.unit: housing units (permits, not starts or completions)

years.note: the 2003 county file's reported column equals its total everywhere (a known defect), so the imputed share is unknown

series.title: new housing units permitted per 1,000 residents
series.label: Calculated

series.note: at a break the population changes estimate (census base); a step in the rate there can be that change, not people moving
